Classical Play-Along

Piece
Bar –

Tap each piano key as its falling block reaches the gold line. No sound? Check Silent Mode is off in Control Centre, and the volume is up.

Each falling block shows the letter to press. Press it on your keyboard as the block reaches the line, or click the piano keys. Rest your fingers on A F G H J K for Ode to Joy.

Piano: Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm (CC BY 3.0). Cellos and double bass: Versilian Community Sample Library (CC0).
